routes.name: GCC Citizen Entry
routes.summary: Citizens of Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Saudi Arabia and the UAE do not need a visa to enter Qatar.

routes.name: Visa-Free Entry
routes.summary: Citizens of over 102 countries get free entry on arrival. Qatar says this is the new name for what used to be called visa on arrival. Some nationalities must hold a Discover Qatar hotel registration before they travel. Use the eligibility tool on Visit Qatar for your passport.

other: Check your passport in the Visit Qatar visa checker.
Some nationalities need a hotel registration booked through Discover Qatar before travel.
Stay length per nationality is not stated on the page text.

routes.name: Visa on Arrival (select nationalities)
routes.summary: Some nationalities pay a fee to get a visa on arrival, or apply for a tourist visa before travel. Visit Qatar lists these nationalities and says visas on the Hayya platform cost QAR 100. The exact fee at the airport is not stated.

other: Fee-paying nationality list is on the Visit Qatar visas page.

routes.name: Hayya E-Visa (Tourist Visa A1)
routes.summary: Anyone who is not visa-free, or from a fee-paying nationality, can apply online on the Hayya platform. The tourist visa costs QAR 100. Hayya also issues the GCC Resident Visa (A2), Visa with ETA (A3) and Visa for companion of GCC citizen (A4).

other: Open to nationals of all countries except GCC citizens, who need no visa.

routes.name: Qatar-Oman Joint Tourist Visa
routes.summary: Issued on arrival. Valid 30 days for both Qatar and Oman with multiple entries. Extendable 30 more days for a fee. Open to the nationalities listed on Visit Qatar.

stay.note: Extendable for 30 more days for a fee.

routes.name: Transit Visa (Doha Transit Tour)
routes.summary: Qatar Airways passengers with at least 6 hours at Hamad International Airport who are not visa-free can apply for a transit visa at the Discover Qatar Transit Desk in the airport. Terms apply.

routes.name: Entrepreneur Residency (Invest Qatar / Jusour)
routes.summary: Long-term self-sponsored residency for founders endorsed by a recognized Qatar business incubator. You can sponsor family and domestic workers and own assets. Renewable. Duration is not stated.

savings.note: Minimum bank balance over the last 3 months for applicants already in Qatar. Overseas applicants need an attested 3 month statement with at least USD 10,000.

other: Endorsement letter from a recognized incubator in Qatar.
Overseas applicants also need an attested police clearance certificate and a passport valid 6+ months.

steps: Your incubator nominates you to Jusour with an endorsement letter.
You get a link to apply.
Fill in the form and upload documents.
Residing applicants get a QID. Overseas applicants get an entrepreneur entry permit, then do the medical test, fingerprinting and QID after landing.

routes.name: Executive Residency (Invest Qatar / Jusour)
routes.summary: Long-term residency for senior executives already living in Qatar, nominated by their employer. Renewable. You can sponsor family and domestic workers.

income.note: For Chairman, COO, CTO, CFO and CEO. QAR 80,000 per month for other Executive Director titles.

other: At least 5 years in a senior executive role, in Qatar or abroad.
Direct contract with a Qatar Stock Exchange listed company, a bank or financial institution, a licensed insurer, or a qualifying consulting firm.
Employer nomination on the Jusour platform. Company acceptance is at Jusour's discretion.
Applicant must already hold a QID.

routes.name: Permanent Residency Card (Law No. 10 of 2018)
routes.summary: Residents need 20 years of legal residence in Qatar if born abroad, or 10 if born in Qatar. Wives, husbands and children of Qataris and some other groups are exempt from these conditions. A committee at the Ministry of Interior decides each case.

other: 20 years legal residence if born abroad, 10 years if born in Qatar.
Good conduct and no final conviction for a dishonorable offense, in Qatar or abroad.
Exempt: non-Qatari spouses of Qataris, children of Qatari women married to non-Qataris, children of naturalized Qataris, and people with great services to the state or special skills Qatar needs.
Income amount is not published. You need enough to support yourself and your family.

steps: Check eligibility with your QID on the MOI portal.
Log in with a smart card to the MOI e-services portal.
Choose Residency, then Permanent Residency, then New Request.
Attach the documents the committee asks for and submit.
